# PerchTV 0.1.22

PerchTV is now its own app, under a new name on your television.

## WHAT CHANGED

- PerchTV has a new app identity, the one it will carry in the app stores. Your television installs it as a new app: open it, pair your phone again with the nine digits it shows, then remove the old PerchTV.
- The pairing screen now reads "Scan this, or enter the digits in the app on your phone", because more than one phone app can pair with it.
- The television now plays each stream with the player name your phone asks for, and uses its own name, PerchTV, when the phone names none. Update the phone app first.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing that lasts until you unpair, the remote's controls, and the television's questions all work as before.
